window_policy: All inputs and target within split; 33 contiguous complete hours; no interpolation
gru_policy: Frozen uploaded FP32 and INT8 artifacts, no training or tuning
ridge_selection: minimum validation RMSE; ascending alpha tie-break
ridge_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on train windows only
ridge_training: train only; no refit on validation
baseline_policy: persistence input[-1]; seasonal input[-24] on every common window
interpretation: New temporal holdout for this analysis; not a preregistered study and not a new household. Authors' prior use of period unknown.
device_extension: Not measured until physical-device evaluation; do not substitute local INT8 for ESP32
